en.bdb: Gurmukhs accept the will of that Lord as truth and they love His will.
Bowing at the feet of the true Guru, they shed their sense of ego.
As disciples, they please the Guru and the heart of the Gum becomes happy.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਨ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਵਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sahaj subhai na alakh lakhaavanaa|

en.bdb: The gurmukh realises the imperceptible Lord spontaneously.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਤਿਲ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gursikh til na tamai kaar kamaavanaa|

en.bdb: The Sikh of Guru has no greed at all and he earns his livelihood by the labour of his hands.
Merging his consciousness into the word he obeys the commands of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਲੰਘਾਇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: veeh ikeeh la(n)ghai nij ghar jaavanaa|

en.bdb: Crossing beyond the worldly illusions he abides in his own real self.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal pai sahaj samaavanaa ||11||

en.bdb: This way, the gurmukhs having attained the pleasure fruit absorb themselves in equipoise.
